models.title: Business Management – B.S.
rulesNotes: The standard-path course values are WGU competency units. Source semester credits, where published, remain separately attached to outside-course options.

Current published WGU agreements7112rev186(Sophia)and4429rev114(Study.com) explicitly bind the included outside courses to Business Management202605. Their program-specific receiving awards supersede older provider-only candidates; original source-credit quantities remain separate.

General education is labeled only where the retained official guide identifies the course under that heading. Remaining named courses stay in core requirements; provider subject labels are not treated as university degree categories.
The November 2026 university catalog independently verifies all 36 named WGU course codes, their competency-unit amounts and the 110-CU BSMGT 202605 total.

The program-specific guideline identifies eight nontransferable WGU courses totaling 26 CU, including the 4-CU QGT1 capstone. These are enforced as university-only; this is distinct from the broader residency sufficient check.
Current core term charges are $3,850 tuition plus $200 resource fee per six months, with a separate $65 application fee. Personal completion timing remains a pace scenario, not a promise.

Primary WGU handbook23797, updatedSeptember18,2026, requires25%ofdegreeCUs directly within the active program in addition to capstone; for this110CUledger the verified calculated floor is31.5CU including QGT1.

The executable outside options are limited to source codes printed in the currently published approved program240 agreements. The same original learning action cannot satisfy two receiving requirements.

Certifications were not factored in for transfer but can be transferred if applicable, passed, and documented. All certifications and IT-specific courses must have been completed within the past five years to be considered for transfer. Verify certifications for each program by going to General Transfer Guidelines . This evaluation is based upon current transfer policies and is not guaranteed in perpetuity. Please contact your Enrollment Counselor if your start date is more than 30 days from the date of this evaluation to determine if any updates to transfer policies have occurred that will change the results of your evaluation. Competency units are based on semester units for transfer. Transfer courses may not be used to fulfill more than one course of study. Students must complete at least 25% of the required undergraduate degree competency units through residency requirements.

notes: $4,050 per six-month term combines $3,850 tuition and the $200 resource fee. The $65 application fee is separate and is not charged each term.
Outside learning, optional costs, financial aid, discounts and individual remaining-term count are not included. A six-month billing period is not a guaranteed degree completion time.

externalMaxCredits.note: Overall 75% program transfer ceiling; exact mapped-course and residency restrictions can require more WGU coursework.

alternativeMaxCredits.note: Alternative learning shares the overall ceiling; no additional credit allowance is added on top.

conservativeSufficientCondition.derivation: The current handbook requires25%of110degreeCUs within the active program in addition to capstone:27.5noncapstoneWGUCU+4CUQGT1. The existing check directly enforces this primary-source rule.

notes: At least25% of the110required degree CUs must be earned directly within the active WGU program, in addition to the required4CUcapstone:27.5noncapstone+4capstone=31.5CU.
Prior completed WGU-program credits and transferred certifications are not automatically current-program residency; only the handbook-defined reviewed exceptions can apply.

historicalWording.wording: at least 25% of the required Degree Competency Units (excluding the capstone course) at WGU
historicalWording.retrieval: Earlier indexed wording; current handbook resolves the additional-capstone basis.

notes: Complete transfer courses and have original official records evaluated before the first WGU term; no later transfer awards are assumed.
After the original term courses are completed, additional courses may be added with the program mentor. Student mastery and assessment completion determine pace.
The transfer deadline uses the current institutional catalog fifth-day rule; earlier receipt is safer than the marketing page summary.
A generic CU/semester-credit learning equivalence is not proof of an individual outside course award; every source quantity remains separate.

Study.com's College Algebra (Math 101) is a self-paced college algebra online course for college credit, recommended by both the American Council on Education (ACE) and the National College Credit Recommendation Service (NCCRS) for 3 transferable semester hours (ACE Course ID: SDCM-0013). Earn 4 credits online in an ACE-recommended Calculus I class (SDCM-0016): limits to series. Learn at your own pace, then transfer the credits to 2,000+ colleges.
Study.com's Calculus (Math 104) is a self-paced, online Calculus I course for college credit that takes you from limits and continuity through derivatives, integrals, and infinite series. unresolved.message: These are the complete named standard-path courses in the cited WGU guide. Current individual transfer approval and receiving level remain unresolved on each outside option.
University courses without an outside option are not proof that no transfer exists. Additional approved provider matches require further current program-specific research.

rulesNotes: The standard-path course values are WGU competency units. Source semester credits, where published, remain separately attached to outside-course options.

Sophia partnership table lists a75% ceiling for combined nontraditional training and credit-by-exam, and identifies postMarch2026 upper-division restrictions. Individual academic residency may require more WGU work.

General education is labeled only where the retained official guide identifies the course under that heading. Remaining named courses stay in core requirements; provider subject labels are not treated as university degree categories.

Certifications were not factored in for transfer but can be transferred if applicable, passed, and documented. All certifications and IT-specific courses must have been completed within the past five years to be considered for transfer. Verify certifications for each program by going to General Transfer Guidelines . This evaluation is based upon current transfer policies and is not guaranteed in perpetuity. Please contact your Enrollment Counselor if your start date is more than 30 days from the date of this evaluation to determine if any updates to transfer policies have occurred that will change the results of your evaluation. Competency units are based on semester units for transfer. Transfer courses may not be used to fulfill more than one course of study. Students must complete at least 25% of the required undergraduate degree competency units through residency requirements.

notes: Published tuition per six-month term. Confirm current mandatory fees, materials, financial-aid eligibility and the applicable program catalog. This is not a quoted total degree cost.

externalMaxCredits.note: Overall university ceiling. Exact receiving-course approval and required WGU coursework may allow fewer outside CUs.

alternativeMaxCredits.note: Alternative credit shares the overall ceiling; this is not approval of any provider or outside course.

policyReview.message: The complete 38-course, 115-CU BSC 202510 curriculum is enforced through its current named receiving requirements. A separate semester upper-level aggregate is not assumed; outside-course approvals and required institutional work remain separate checks.

conservativeSufficientCondition.derivation: 25% of active undergraduate degree CUs earned directly in that WGU program, in addition to required capstone CUs.

notes: Only passed CUs earned within the active WGU program count toward this rule. Prior WGU or other outside credit is not automatically counted as active-program residency.

Please contact your Enrollment Counselor if your start date is more than 30 days from the date of this evaluation to determine if any updates to transfer policies have occurred that will change the results of your evaluation. Competency units are based on semester units for transfer. Transfer courses may not be used to fulfill more than one course of study. Students must complete at least 25% of the required undergraduate degree competency units through residency requirements.
